title: BJP IT Cell: the Short
status: script draft (not rendered: the owner has not said go)
notes: S2 needs the BJP's own upload (evidence slot). Party symbols left out until the official files are downloaded. Right-of-reply before release.

scenes.narration: A catchy political rap reel. Harmless?
On the party's own YouTube channel, 2018: Amit Shah told volunteers any message could go viral, true or false. He added it shouldn't be done.
scenes.graphic: Footage: EVIDENCE-SLOT bjp-kota-2018 | in: 26:30 | The party's *own upload*, Kota, 22 Sep 2018 | badge: verified | logo: youtube

scenes.narration: Break the phone open. Behind one post, reporting found a core team, designers and a sign-off.
scenes.graphic: Explode: phone | THE POST: your screen; THE SIGN-OFF: one official, every post (Delhi); THE DESIGN: about 20 designers (UP); THE THEME: a 25-member core team (UP) | Break it open | badge: reported

scenes.narration: In Delhi, one official signs off every post, reports say.
scenes.graphic: Conveyor: APPROVED | 6 | In Delhi, one official signs off every post | Every post, *one sign-off* | badge: reported

scenes.narration: For 2019, the party planned a phone volunteer at every booth: about 900,000, by reports.
scenes.graphic: Counter: 0 → 900,000 | booth volunteers planned for 2019 | one report said nearly 1 lakh | badge: reported

scenes.narration: In Bihar in 2020, party leaders said 72,000 WhatsApp groups were planned. Over a lakh were formed, its convenor said.
scenes.graphic: Tiles: Bihar | 72 | 1 tile = 1,000 groups | Bihar, 2020: *72,000* groups | 72,000 WhatsApp groups planned (party leaders to ThePrint); over 1 lakh formed (state convenor to Caravan) | badge: reported | logo: whatsapp

scenes.narration: Fact-checkers flagged the IT cell's then-head 17 times, one 2020 tally found.
scenes.graphic: Pile: 17 | FALSE, MISLEADING | Flagged *17 times* | Posts by the IT cell's then-head flagged by fact-checkers (The News Minute, 2020) | badge: reported

scenes.narration: But it isn't one party. Oxford researchers found junk news on both sides' Facebook pages: 28 in 100 links, and 21.
scenes.graphic: Grids: pro-BJP pages 28, pro-Congress pages 21 | It isn't *one party* | Shared news links rated junk news on Facebook pages, 2019 (Oxford Internet Institute) | badge: reported | logo: facebook

scenes.narration: In 2024, police arrested Congress social-media workers over a doctored video of Amit Shah. They're on bail; Congress says the BJP is the expert in fakes.
scenes.graphic: Statement: MAY 2024 · Police arrest Congress social-media workers over a *doctored video* of Amit Shah | badge: verified

scenes.narration: And the money: the party's own filing shows 156.95 crore rupees to Google and 24.63 crore to Facebook in 2024.
scenes.graphic: Table: Item, ₹ crore | Total election spending, 1,737.68; Media advertisement, 611.50; Google India, 156.95; Facebook, 24.63 | The party's own filing, 2024 | Election Commission | highlight: 3 | badge: verified | logo: google, facebook

scenes.narration: In August 2026 the party changed its IT cell chief. The posts got catchier, reports say.
scenes.graphic: Reel: rap | New chief. *New beat.* | badge: reported
